newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse to cut bond trading commission.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse to cut bond trading commission.

text.p: The Shanghai Stock Exchange plans to cut the commission its members charge customers for trading state debt spot contracts to 0.2 percent from 0.3 percent from March 3, Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
The commission the bourse charges for trading other bonds will also be cut to 0.2 percent, the newspaper said.
The bond trading commission the exchange charges its members will not change, it said.
The exchange charges its members a commission of less than 0.15 percent on bond transactions, traders said.
